normalized_exact_match_rate.description: Fraction of predictions exactly matching the reference after case and whitespace normalization.

normalized_edit_similarity.description: Character-level Levenshtein similarity after case and whitespace normalization.

token_jaccard_similarity.description: Macro-average Jaccard similarity over unique prediction and reference tokens.

token_overlap_f1.description: Macro-average bag-of-words token overlap F1 against the reference.

rouge_l_f1.description: Macro-average longest-common-subsequence token F1 against the reference.

character_ngram_f1.description: Macro-average character 1- through 6-gram overlap F1 against the reference.

word_count_mae.description: Mean absolute error in response word count.

line_count_mae.description: Mean absolute error in nonblank response-line count.

prediction_repeat_2024_rate.description: Fraction of predictions that repeat the 2024 response after normalization.

observed_repeat_2024_rate.description: Fraction of reference responses that repeat the 2024 response after normalization.

source_similarity_mae.description: Mean absolute error between predicted and observed ROUGE-L similarity to the 2024 response.

prediction_source_similarity_mean.description: Mean ROUGE-L similarity between predictions and 2024 responses.

observed_source_similarity_mean.description: Mean ROUGE-L similarity between follow-up and 2024 responses.
